title: Every grid row fetches the same owner record again
why: Each request returns 200 and the owner cells fill in. Only the network timeline shows the same user being fetched over and over.
finding: Each `OwnerCell` calls `fetchUser(ownerId)` on mount. 7 identical `GET /api/users/23` fired within 99ms at load and 2 more on each row click, 11 in all, although `fetchUsers(ids)` already exists for batching.
actual: 11 identical GET requests to /api/users/23 are issued: 7 in a burst at initial load (1576ms, 1578ms, 1602ms, 1624ms, 1635ms, 1645ms, 1675ms — all 200, durations 1133ms to 9310ms), 2 more after the first row click at 121264ms/121288ms, and 2 more after the second click at 167697ms/167699ms. Each OwnerCell mounts its own fetch and the results are never shared, so the same user record is transferred and processed repeatedly.
expected: The owner for ownerId 23 should be fetched once (deduplicated across the 50 OwnerCell instances, or fetched for all rows in a single batched call via the existing fetchUsers(ids) endpoint) and reused from a shared cache/state; owner names should appear after one request round-trip.

chronology.text: At page load (1576–1675ms) the grid mounts 50 rows, each rendering an OwnerCell for ownerId 23; 7 identical GET requests to /api/users/23 fire within 99ms (durations 1133–9310ms), and the owner cells remain in their skeleton 'owner-loading' state while these redundant requests are in flight.

rootCause.text: src/components/OwnerCell.jsx issues fetchUser(ownerId) inside a useEffect that runs on every component mount (line 9), and src/state/columns.jsx line 97 renders one \<OwnerCell ownerId={r.ownerId}/> per grid row. With 50 rows all referencing ownerId 23, every mounting row independently requests the same /api/users/23 endpoint — 11 mounts fired during the recording — with no deduplication, shared cache, or use of the existing batch endpoint fetchUsers(ids) in src/lib/api.js (line 28). Confirmed by the network log: 11 GETs to /api/users/23, all 200, including 7 within 99ms at load with durations 1133–9310ms.
